title: fix(plugin-security)!: a person-to-permission-set assignment refuses an agent ceiling set at every write door
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuLBXff21cMaYo16jV4jZerR)_

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — a non-system insert or update of `sys_user_permission_set` that would store an assignment naming one of the three MCP agent ceiling sets (`mcp_agent_data_read`, `mcp_agent_data_write`, `mcp_agent_restricted`) is refused with `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` (`invalid_value` at `permission_set`), for every caller, a platform administrator included; nothing is widened.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — `skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md` teaches the permission-set assignment door generically and never names the MCP agent ceiling sets, so nothing it teaches changes; the refusal's own message names the way through (choose a person's set, or delete the assignment).

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:人员权限集分配表 `sys_user_permission_set` 的每个写入口(单条新建、更新、`createMany`、`updateMany`、两种批量、两种导入)现在拒绝存入三个 MCP 智能体上限权限集,统一返回 `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`,字段 `permission_set`、代码 `invalid_value`。
- **为什么改**:这三个权限集是经 MCP 接入的 AI 助手自己的权限上限,由其用户同意的范围在请求时推导,从不读分配行;分配表的每一行都是给人的授权,所以规则在服务端对每个写入口、每个调用者(平台管理员也不例外)成立。
- **风险与回滚**:破坏性收窄,只影响曾经通过分配表给人分配这三个集的部署:新写入和对此类旧行的编辑被拒,旧行原样保留、可删除或改名;系统写入(种子回放、平台自身授权写入)不受影响;回滚即 revert 本 PR(一个新钩子模块加一行注册)。
- **先看**:① `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/agent-ceiling-grant-refusal.ts` 的 `onUpdate`(以写后行判定,覆盖按谓词的多行更新);② `security-plugin-start-hooks.ts` 新增的注册行;③ `packages/qa/dogfood/test/grant-table-write-contract.dogfood.test.ts` 新增的顶层 describe 块。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run src/agent-ceiling-grant-refusal.test.ts`,预期 `Tests 14 passed (14)`。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **The rule (ADR-0090 D10).** The MCP agent ceiling sets (`MCP_AGENT_PERMISSION_SETS`, imported from `@objectstack/spec/ai`, never retyped) are an AI agent's own grants: the door that admits an agent connected over MCP derives the ceiling from the scopes its user consented to and puts it on the agent's request. No assignment row is read for it, and no `sys_user` row is an agent principal, so every `sys_user_permission_set` row is a person's grant and never names one.
- **Where it holds.** A new module, `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/agent-ceiling-grant-refusal.ts`, registers a `beforeInsert` and a `beforeUpdate` engine hook on `sys_user_permission_set` (priority 35: after the catalog check that the name is a set at all, before the holder's membership is read). Every door that writes the table writes through the engine, so each one is covered: the data API's create and update, `createMany`, `updateMany`, the per-object and cross-object batch, and the sync and job import doors.
- **Which rows are judged.** An insert judges the row's set. An update judges the set the row holds after the write: the payload's `permission_set` when it carries one, the stored one when it does not. So an update that keeps an assignment naming a ceiling in force (a new holder, a validity window, an echo of the set) is refused as well as a rename to a ceiling, by id and by predicate.
- **What it leaves alone.** A delete is never judged. A system write (`isSystem`: seed replay, the platform's own grant writers) is not judged. Every other permission set stays assignable. An agent principal's ceiling is resolved exactly as before. An organization administrator is still refused the same sets on the organization boundary first (`403 PERMISSION_DENIED`).
- **The envelope.** `validationFailure` (the constructor both HTTP doors map) with one `fields[]` entry: `field: 'permission_set'`, `code: 'invalid_value'` (the ADR-0114 member: the set exists, so it is not `reference_not_found`), `value`, and a sentence naming the way through. No new error code (ADR-0112).
- **Registration.** `security-plugin-start-hooks.ts` calls `registerAgentCeilingGrantRefusal(ql, ctx.logger)` beside the permission-set name hooks. It is idempotent on a re-run of `start()`, and warns and returns `false` on an engine with no hook registry.
- **Public surface.** Unchanged: none of the new module's symbols is re-exported from the package entry (measured on the built `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/index.d.mts`: 0 hits for each of the five names, positive control `SecurityPlugin` 24 hits each).
- **Changeset.** `.changeset/sec-hardening-r6-agent-ceiling-grant.md`, `patch` on `@objectstack/plugin-security` with a BREAKING banner, both declaration lines, its ADR-0087 disposition, and the fix for a deployment that holds such an assignment (delete it, or rename it to a set meant for people).
- **System-context register.** `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` gains row 23f: a system writer of `sys_user_permission_set` is not judged by this check, and a non-system write that would store an assignment naming an MCP agent ceiling set is refused for every caller. Its generated site register now names `agent-ceiling-grant-refusal.ts#onInsert` and `#onUpdate` under that row (regenerated with `node scripts/check-system-context-census.mjs --write`).

## Tests

- **`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/agent-ceiling-grant-refusal.test.ts`** (new, 14 tests; real ObjectQL engine, SQL driver on in-memory SQLite, the real `SecurityPlugin` started on it):
  - each of the three ceiling sets is refused on insert by a platform administrator (`400`, `VALIDATION_FAILED`, one field entry `permission_set` / `invalid_value` / the value), and nothing is stored;
  - a batch insert with one ceiling row among person grants is refused whole;
  - an update by id renaming a grant to a ceiling, and a predicate update renaming several, are refused and leave every row untouched;
  - an update that keeps a stored ceiling assignment in force (new holder, new window, echo of the set, by predicate) is refused;
  - controls: a person's set is assignable; renaming a stored ceiling assignment to a person's set, and deleting one, both land; system inserts and a system update stand down; an agent principal still resolves its ceiling with no assignment row while a person resolves none;
  - registration is idempotent, and an engine with no hook registry gets `false` and one warning.
- **`packages/qa/dogfood/test/grant-table-write-contract.dogfood.test.ts`** (new top-level block, 8 tests on the booted showcase stack over HTTP; its `beforeAll` asserts the shipped catalog serves all three ceiling sets, so the catalog check does not answer first):
  - `POST` of each ceiling set, and a `PATCH` renaming a person grant to one, answer the full envelope and store nothing;
  - `createMany` and the cross-object `/batch` answer the full envelope;
  - `updateMany` and the per-object batch fail the row in their per-row report with `code: 'VALIDATION_FAILED'`, `httpStatus: 400`;
  - the sync import and the import job fail the row with `code: 'invalid_value'` at `permission_set`.
- **Ablation.** With the guard line replaced by a no-op (via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored automatically): the unit file goes 7 failed / 7 passed (every refusal pin red, every control green), and the dogfood block, rebuilt and checked with `scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs`, goes 5 failed / 3 passed (the 3 are the file's existing grant-table pins), and each of the four door pins after the first, run alone so no earlier row feeds a later one, also goes red. Restored and rebuilt, both are green again.

## Acceptance notes

- **The per-row report doors carry no `fields[]`.** `updateMany` and the per-object batch answer `200` with a per-row report whose failed row carries the refusal's `code` and `httpStatus` but not its `fields[]` entry; that is those doors' existing report shape for every validation refusal, not something this change introduces, so it is pinned as it stands.
- **Stored assignments are not migrated.** An assignment stored before this release that names a ceiling set is left in place and can no longer be edited; the changeset gives the query to list them and the two ways to clear one.
- **Clause-② spelling.** The diff narrows the accept set and widens nothing (no new export reaches the package entry), so the declaration is `no (narrowing)`.

## Verification
